description: Persistent find & replace panel: full result list, match counting, mark all, and cross-file search. The search core is written in Rust.
viewContainer.title: Search
view.name: Search
view.files.name: File Search
config.title: Search
config.wrapAround: Wrap to the beginning after reaching the end of the document
config.searchInSelection: Search the selection only (when text is selected)
config.highlightAllMatches: Highlight all matches in the editor after searching
config.maxMatches: Upper limit of matches returned by a single search
config.maxMatchesPerFile: Maximum matches kept per file during a cross-file search (default 2000), so one huge log cannot exhaust the global budget.
config.walkThreads: Number of worker threads for filesystem enumeration. 0 = auto (CPU cores / 4, clamped 2-8), -1 = enumerate in the extension host, 1-16 = fixed. Enumeration is a producer pipeline; workers only walk and filter.
config.walkOrder: Enumeration order. 'fast' consumes batches as they arrive (max throughput); 'sorted' merges shard streams into global lexicographic order so the same tree and query always produce identical results (matters when hits exceed the 20000 match cap).
config.maxFileSizeKB: Maximum file size (KB) included in a search. Files over the limit are named in the result card instead of being skipped silently. Default 512000 (500 MB). Files above 2 MB are streamed in chunks, so memory does not grow with file size.
config.streamThresholdKB: Files larger than this (KB) are searched in streaming chunks with constant memory. Default 2048 (2 MB); set to 0 to stream every file.
config.backtrackLimit: Regex backtracking step limit, to stop catastrophic backtracking
config.includeGlob: File filter for Find in Files (comma-separated, glob supported)
config.excludeGlob: Glob patterns excluded from Find in Files (comma-separated)
config.takeOverFindShortcut: Open this panel with Ctrl+F / Ctrl+H (overrides VS Code's built-in find)
config.chunkAboveMB: Files larger than this (MB) are candidates for line-aligned chunked scanning. Default 2. The final decision is made per file by a time-budget estimate (usually worth it from about 4 MB); set to 0 to disable chunking entirely.
config.chunkCrowdMB: While the pool still has plenty of bytes left to scan, only files larger than this (MB) are split into chunks. Default 2 (same as the chunk threshold, so anything chunked is split); set 0 to disable the gate, or 32 for the conservative behaviour.
config.diskType: Controls whether huge files are split across workers. On rotational disks parallel reads become random seeks, so chunking is disabled when a HDD is detected. auto = use the probe (sysfs on Linux, Get-PhysicalDisk on Windows, diskutil on macOS); ssd = always split; hdd = never split.
config.chunkMemoryMB: Memory budget per worker for chunk buffers (MB). Chunk size + overlap never exceeds it. Default 32.
config.parallelWorkers: Parallel scan threads for Find in Files: 0 = auto (scales with file count, capped at 16, minimum 2), 1~16 = fixed, -1 = off. Large local workspaces only; falls back to in-host scan otherwise.
config.verboseLog: Log one line per scanned file (file / hit / skip) to the output panel. Off by default: synchronous logging for tens of thousands of files slows the scan noticeably. Summary lines are always logged.
